reason: Name-collision false positive: Gametime United, Inc. is a consumer live-event ticketing marketplace in San Francisco (gametime.co, ~168-308 employees, $77M raised through a May 2022 Series C, now PE-backed per PitchBook), not a game studio - there is no Unreal/Unity build pipeline, no publisher milestone, and no full-production game, so Ben Cole's PC/console studio technical-operations niche does not apply; the four matched jobs are generic product engineering hires (Fullstack, Front End, Staff Mobile Tech Lead) plus a VP Marketplace Operations focused on post-purchase fan support, and the fresh feed adds only Director of Web Growth and a marketing data scientist - no build, DevOps, IT, security, cloud, or release-ops confession anywhere, and the one JD line touching infrastructure ('engineers take end-to-end ownership across product, platform, and infrastructure') states a deliberate no-central-ops-layer philosophy rather than pain from an unowned ops layer.
